# Decision rank content-first (Grok Bot)

- **DecisionRank v2: content-first todo ordering (0.7 content / 0.3 fields), per-todo reason, no confidence gate**: Shanta 2026-10-07: the order echoed the fields. The model state included P/status/due, so nimble repeated them, and the gate floated only high-confidence rows over field-ordered rows. Now the state is title+description+project only. Each todo gets a content urgency/impact score plus a reason choice (broken/blocking/impact/deadline/quickwin/housekeeping). The order is blend = w_c*content + w_f*field rank, with w_c set by --weight-content or COMSERV_RANK_W_CONTENT (default 0.7). Cache is v2. Real run 08:47 PT: nimble 152 s, 40 questions, 227K local tokens, $0. Model-vs-field tau dropped from 0.45-0.65 to 0.15; 16 of the top 20 changed position. Undo: `cd ~/.comserv/worktrees/aisystem/Comserv && git restore Comserv/lib/Comserv/Util/AI/DecisionRank.pm Comserv/script/compute_decision_rank.pl Comserv/root/admin/planning/_today_work_tab.tt Comserv/lib/Comserv/Controller/Planning.pm && rm Comserv/t/ai_decision_rank_content.t && cp /tmp/r2/ai_rank_order.json.before Comserv/data/ai_rank_order.json`
- **RankQuality: divergence from field order + worked_in_final_top5**: Adds tau_final_vs_coded, divergence = 1 - tau (0 = same as field order), and worked_in_final_top5. Undo: `cp /tmp/r2/RankQuality.pm.r2 Comserv/lib/Comserv/Util/AI/RankQuality.pm`
